title: First-order agreement of a Lipschitz map on an open set with C¹ maps off an Lⁿ-null set (Simon Ch. 2, Thms 1.2, 1.4, 1.5)
lean_statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ), (∀ (F : Rn n → Rn m) (K : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith K F → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ g : Rn n → Rn m, ContDiff ℝ 1 g ∧ volume {x | F x ≠ g x ∨ fderiv ℝ F x ≠ fderiv ℝ g x} < ε) → ∀ (D : Set (Rn n)) (h : Rn n → Rn m), IsOpen D → (∃ K, LipschitzOnWith K h D) → ∃ (G : ℕ → Rn n → Rn m) (E : ℕ → Set (Rn n)), (∀ i, ContDiff ℝ 1 (G i)) ∧ (∀ i, MeasurableSet (E i)) ∧ (∀ i, E i ⊆ D) ∧ (∀ i, ∀ u ∈ E i, h u = G i u ∧ HasFDerivAt h (fderiv ℝ (G i) u) u) ∧ volume (D \ ⋃ i, E i) = 0
